task.title: Adapter prototype: ordered re-entrant operation pipeline

donor.borrowed: mechanism only: a step is the first applicable operation in an ordered list; policies are re-entrant operations over persisted state

files.role: command envelope, status vocabulary, plan validation, idempotency key, capability profiles
MemoryStore + FileStore atomic commit, schema fail-closed, initial session
Craft port, approval policy, verifier, continuation note; reference doubles
file-backed Craft boundary double (survives process exit)
real crash child: exit 9 after effect, before result

pipeline.name: approval
pipeline.applicable: next step gated and undecided, or require_human pending
pipeline.terminal: halt DENIED_BY_POLICY on deny; yields on require_human

pipeline.name: retry
pipeline.applicable: a failed step exists with feedback

pipeline.name: verify
pipeline.terminal: marks step failed so retry decides

pipeline.name: finalize
pipeline.applicable: no pending/failed steps and no inFlight
pipeline.terminal: yields awaiting_evidence when a required criterion is unverified

keys.name: schemaVersion
keys.purpose: fail closed on mismatch; never silently resume

keys.name: writerId
keys.purpose: refuse a session written by another adapter

keys.name: episodeId
keys.purpose: refuse cross-episode resume; scopes idempotency keys

keys.name: plan
keys.purpose: ordered steps with request, requiresApproval, status, attempts, lastFeedback

keys.name: events
keys.purpose: append-only log, one event per step, contiguous seq

keys.name: inFlight
keys.purpose: write-ahead intents (idempotencyKey, planStepId, commandId, attempt, startedAt)

keys.name: ledgerEntries
keys.purpose: outcome history per idempotency key (status, observation, undoToken, reconciledVia)

keys.name: evidence
keys.purpose: verification rows: kind, holds, label V/U, evidence payload, source

keys.name: approvals
keys.purpose: decision + decidedBy + reason per plan step

keys.name: counters
keys.purpose: dispatches, duplicates, repairs, compactions, checkpoints, failures

keys.name: halt/finished
keys.purpose: terminal states that block further work

dispatchProtocol: duplicate check against ledger: completed/terminal => suppress; repairable => allow retry
append intent to inFlight and COMMIT (write-ahead)
append result event + ledger entry and COMMIT

idempotency.stability: pure function; identical across retries and resumes
idempotency.scoping: episode-scoped; same step id in another episode yields a different key
idempotency.duplicateRule: last ledger entry with status OK or a non-repairable status is final; repairable statuses are attempts and may be re-dispatched

crashMatrix.test: unresolvable intent halts with MANUAL_RECONCILE instead of guessing
crash after the effect: resume reconciles by inspect and never re-executes

crashMatrix.point: app cannot answer, document proves it
crashMatrix.onDisk: intent + mutated document, no effect log
crashMatrix.test: when the app cannot answer, declared postconditions decide the recovery
replaying a completed step is suppressed

proves: happy path finishes with 2 ledger entries
deny halts before any app call
real process crash resumes without double effect

stubSweep.note: the only double is the documented Craft boundary double in test/fixtures/, never imported by src/

limits: no real Craft transport; craftPort must be bound to Craft IPC/CLI/MCP
Craft's ability to answer inspect(idempotencyKey) is unverified; postcondition verification is the tested fallback
continuation note is deterministic, not model-written (single port call to replace)
token estimate is chars/4, adequate to exercise the pipeline but not to tune production budgets
verifier covers document-shape assertions only; pixel diff remains secondary
single-writer assumption: two conductors on one session directory would race; needs a lock
no subagent runtime, telemetry sink or pixel verification in this wave
nextSteps: bind craftPort to a real Craft command surface and re-run the suite

replace deterministic note with a model call only after the ledger can prove reuse
add a session lock before embedding the conductor in a long-lived service
